source: Engine audit of 2026-10-18 (plan docs/ENGINE_AUDIT.md), verdicts after the fixes

items.mechanic: Commit, date, git status
Build of engine_cs.Cli
Golden traces check
Engine unit tests
Sheet Assumptions
EnemyStatusData fields and offsets
items.rule: FORMULAS 5c / 9: "EnemyStatusData records enemy base statistics (level, HP, ATK, DEF, INT, RES, DEX, AGI), 8 elemental resistances in order (slash, stab, bash, fire, water, wind, earth, lightning), damage swing at offset 0x40, turn wait weight at offset 0x44, ailment immunity bitflags at offset 0x3C, and passive skills at offset 0xF0/0xF4."
items.reach: All 516 enemies in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: EnemyAttackData fields and target code mapping
items.rule: FORMULAS 9.2: "EnemyAttackData records enemy attack parameters: target code 0x2C, attribute 0x30, chant speed 0x34, accuracy 0x38, power 0x3C, turns 0x40 (float to int), speed 0x44, and five effect slots from 0x4C (id, value, kind)."
items.reach: All 2,375 enemy attacks in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: EnemyAIData and NPCAIData structure and interpretation
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "EnemyAIData / NPCAIData binary scripts encode enemy and NPC behaviour: a sequence of commands ending in 0xFF, where each top-level command specifies an opcode, arguments, a result word, and two tail bytes (once and stop flags), with command 0 defining a set of 16 weights and chained sub-commands omitting the opcode and tail bytes."
items.reach: All 516 enemies and 107 NPCs in `build/engine_snapshot.json` with AI scripts.

items.mechanic: NPCData fields and guest ally construction
items.rule: FORMULAS 5 / 16.5: "NPCData records guest ally parameters: id, character model 0x10, level 0x18, weapon rank index 0x1C (providing turn wait weight via WeaponRankData), six base stats at 0x20, attacks at 0x38/0x3C, passives at 0x94/0x98, hire cost at 0xAC, contract length at 0xB0, and bar unlock flag at 0xB4; passives at 0x98 are applied if the referenced attack is a passive."
items.reach: All 107 guest NPC records in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Summon forms fields and scaling
items.rule: FORMULAS 11: "A summon has three forms recorded in SummonData: the form used is the last whose level is not above the average level of the party; its six base stats scale as max(base, int(best party member stat * factor)) for ATK, DEF, INT, RES, DEX, AGI; its turn wait weight is the delay of the weapon rank at 0x20."
items.reach: All 105 summon forms across 35 grand sealbook summon families in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Dolls creation, owner stats, and 9,999 HP
items.rule: FORMULAS 11.1 / 16.5: "A doll skill creates a doll unit (classes CGamePlayerStatusETCDoll, CGamePlayerStatusOtherETCDoll, CGameEnemyStatusETCDoll) with 9,999 HP and max HP; its base stats copy its owner's base stats, modified by Soul Seal (effect 314); it lasts the turns given by effect 147 of the doll skill."
items.reach: All 7 doll skill types across player classes and guest mercenaries in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Skills of the player (`SKILL_LAYOUTS` in `tools/extract_vanilla.py`)
items.rule: FORMULAS 10.3 / 9.1: "Player skills are loaded from `TechniqueSkillData.pck`, `MagicSkillData.pck`, and `PassiveSkillData.pck` with layouts defined by `SKILL_LAYOUTS`: target code (0x28), attribute (0x2C), per-level TP (0x5C), per-level action speed (0xAC), chant speed (0xD4 in Magic), 5 effect slots (effect id, value per level, kind), weapon restrictions, and range flags."
items.reach: All 312 player skills across Technique (143), Magic (98), and Passive (71) categories in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Items, equipment, enchantments, unique skills, party skills: fields in `Loader.cs`
items.rule: FORMULAS 10 / 12: "Loader reads equipment base stats and upgrade rates, item effects and skill bindings, enchantment stacking flags, and unique skills; party skills and sub event bonuses are out of the model."
items.reach: 551 equipment pieces, 576 items, 129 stacking enchantments, and 18 unique skills in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: The variant: `balance_changes.xlsx` in `gamedata/variant.py` vs `tools/balance_values.py`
items.rule: docs/ENGINE_AUDIT.md 6.1: "For every table of `balance_changes.xlsx` that the engine models, `gamedata/variant.py` must change the same field that `tools/balance_values.py` writes in the game file."
items.reach: 2,184 live rows across modeled battle tables out of 2,392 total live rows in `data_tables/balance_changes.xlsx`.

items.mechanic: Spot check: snapshot values vs raw game file bytes
items.rule: docs/ENGINE_AUDIT.md 6.1: "Spot check: pick 3 enemies, 3 attacks, 3 guests, 3 skills at random (write the seed or the choice) and compare the snapshot values with the bytes of the game file read by the readers."

items.mechanic: Stats of a member: growth row, class modifiers, equipment, crown, weapon rank weight
items.rule: FORMULAS 10, 10.1, 10.4, 12.17: "A party member's stats are derived from the growth row of her class route in ClassLevelData, plus level reset and crown bonuses, equipment stats scaled by upgrade rate and weapon masteries, class specialty modifiers, and turn delay from weapon rank weight."
items.reach: All 18 playable characters across 38 class growth rows and 38 class modifier tables in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: The summon of the grand sealbook: scaling, level, rank, script, passive, number 3000
items.rule: FORMULAS 11: "A grand sealbook summon is built at `0x449771` with unit number 3000 on the party side; form and level are determined by party level, stats scale from the highest party member stat times the form's factors, turn wait weight is the delay of the form's weapon rank, and behaviour follows its AI script and passive."

items.mechanic: A hired guest and her HP
items.rule: FORMULAS 16.5: "A hired guest ally (3001) is built at 0x449839 from the character object [0x71fc24]+0x1424 (0x449879 call 0x435890), number 3001 (0x449892). A guest ally has no HP: 0xAC of its NPCData is the gold of the hire; the tavern offers, of the stages of a guest whose flag (0xB4) is set, the one of the highest level (0x58adb0 - 0x58b060)."
items.note: A guest is never a candidate (lists of units below 2000), so her HP is never read; no counter is set up against her.
items.reach: 107 NPC records across all mercenary stages.

items.mechanic: Dolls at creation: stats, HP, number, inheritance
items.rule: FORMULAS 11.1: "A doll created by a doll skill receives 9,999 HP, unit number in the 2000 range, stats cloned from the owner with Soul Seal bonus if active, life in turns from effect 147, and does not inherit owner's equipment, enchantments, or passives."
items.reach: All 7 doll records (Spartan, Oracles, Mercidarian, Musiy, Catalina, Perdurabo, and Shadow/Genjimaru) in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Rows and formation: who is front and back, and the share table
items.rule: FORMULAS 9.1: "Weight of a living member, recomputed at every pick: weight = share of its position table 0x6517a0, by formation; each row adds up to 100... Rows of the table: (100) (50 50) (60 40) (33 34 33) (38 38 24) (40 30 30) (28 28 28 16) (30 30 20 20) (31 23 23 23) (24 24 24 14 14) (26 26 16 16 16). Read from the figures: one row per party size and number of members in front."
items.reach: All 2,219 formations across all floors and all 196 fixed battles in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Start of battle: initial gauges, random order, ambush, effect 300
items.rule: FORMULAS 16.5: "Start of a battle (0x449130): a member or an enemy starts at a gauge of (a number below 500, plus 1) / 1000, a guest ally or a summon at the value of a plain action; one battle in five every gauge is (a number below 93) / 100."
items.note: Members, enemies and dolls start at the value of a plain action; the summon and a guest at a random gauge unless the enemy flag (bit 1, byte 0x33) is set.
items.reach: All 2,219 formations across all floors and all 196 fixed battles in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Turn value formula: base, weight term, F1, F2, slow, random r, 0.92 cap
items.rule: FORMULAS 5: "base A = (stat + 100) / 200; speed = ( base A * (1 + r) - (weight / 12) * (1 + level / 100) ) * F1 * F2 * slow * 0.5; value = speed * (1 + buffs + enchantments)... value is capped at 0.92; wait until the next turn = 1 - value."
items.reach: Every turn calculation for all units in all battles; covers all 312 player skills and 2,375 enemy/NPC attacks in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Speed stat used: AGI, INT, or RES while chanting
items.rule: FORMULAS 5: "base A = (stat + 100) / 200; stat: AGI; INT or RES while chanting, by a flag of the skill (0x449b4c)."
items.reach: Covers all 98 player spells and all 423 enemy attacks that chant in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Buffs and enchantments of speed and chanting
items.rule: FORMULAS 5: "buffs, added together. Acting: effects 168 (speed buff), 217, 221, and 261 while HP is at or below 40% of max; plus 201, 340, 276, 277 and, in one case, 316. Chanting: effects 214, 265, 281. Enchantments: acting, +0.10 per piece of enchantment 51 (speed UP), +0.05 per piece of 52, -0.10 per piece of 53; chanting, +0.20 per piece of 54 (chant speed UP), +0.10 per piece of 55, -0.20 per
items.reach: Covers all 15 player skills and 121 enemy attacks carrying speed/chant modifiers, all speed enchantments (51-56), and grand sealbook scanner enchantment 298 in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Defend, escape, and plain actions
items.rule: FORMULAS 5: "value = speed * (1 + buffs + enchantments) * 1.15 when defending, * 1.20 when escaping (0x44a316 - 0x44a335)... F1, F2: factors of the action; 1 for a plain action such as defending."
items.reach: Turn evaluation for all defending actions, lost turns, and plain actions across all battles; covers all 312 player skills and 2,375 enemy/NPC attacks in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: The weight of an enemy, a summon, and a guest
items.rule: FORMULAS 5: "weight is a virtual call of the unit (slot 0xf4). For a player it is the delay multiplier of the rank of the equipped weapon (the float of WeaponRankData: 1.00 for A+ up to 2.90 for F). For an enemy it is the float at 0x44 of EnemyStatusData (0x4f2150, slot 0xf4 of the enemy class) [code]. Summons and mercenaries take a rank index from their own record and return the delay of that wea
items.reach: Covers all 516 enemies, 105 summon forms, and 107 guest NPC records in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: Turn order ties: who acts when two units are due at the same time
items.rule: FORMULAS 5 (and the turn order queue comparator at `0x440b5c - 0x440ba0`): when two units have equal wait gauges, ties are broken by a priority key stored at unit wrapper offset `+0xc` (`key = int(gauge * 1000) * 1000 + [unit + 0xc]`), where higher priority key acts first.
items.note: Ties are broken by the order units were inserted (TieKey), as the program's list.
items.reach: Covers battles with a summon or hired guest where an exact turn time tie occurs with an enemy. In `build/engine_snapshot.json`, there are 105 summon forms and 107 guest NPC records.

items.mechanic: Turn denial: petrify, sleep, paralysis, Warning Shot, Magnificent Steps
items.rule: FORMULAS 12.4, 16.5, 16.7 (`0x436c40 - 0x436f8b`): when a unit is about to act, petrification and sleep unconditionally deny the turn without status ticks; paralysis denies the turn on a roll below 100 under 30 without status ticks; Warning Shot (259) replaces the command with an empty action while allowing status ticks; Magnificent Steps (283) and Mesmerized (203) deny the turn on a roll below 10
items.reach: Evaluated on every unit turn in battle. Affects all 14 player skills and 285 enemy/NPC attacks carrying petrify (120), sleep (116), paralysis (115), Warning Shot (259), Magnificent Steps (283), or Mesmerized (203) in `build/engine_snapshot.json`.

items.mechanic: The AI choice loop and set switches
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "Choice of attack (`0x430f10`): the set is 0 at the start of every turn, and the weights are copied back from the script (`0x430f56`, `0x430f91`): a set chosen on one turn does not carry to the next; the commands before the first set run in order until one decides. With no attack decided, a number below the sum of the 16 weights of the current set is rolled and the slot it falls in is
items.note: No cap on set switches; a switch to a set already visited or missing ends the choice on slot 0.
items.reach: Covers all 516 enemy scripts in `build/engine_snapshot.json`, of which 426 contain multiple sets and 3 contain more than 8 sets.

items.mechanic: AI script commands 0 to 15
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "Every command 1 - 15 (table in FORMULAS 9): condition and arguments, against the engine's Passes/FinalResult branches."
items.note: Command conditions compare HP ratios and look up effects as the program does; command 7 rejects a slot whose id differs.
items.reach: Covers all 516 enemy scripts in `build/engine_snapshot.json`, of which 72 use command 7.

items.mechanic: Sources of AI conditions
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "Sources (jump table 0x432fa0, twelve cases): 0 own HP ratio, 1 lowest HP ratio among allies, 2 among opponents, 3 lowest TP ratio among allies, 4 among opponents, 5 an ally with an ailment, 6 an opponent with an ailment, 7 a chanting opponent, 8 an opponent in the back row, 9 in the front row, 10 an opponent with a buff, 11 an ally with a debuff."
items.note: Ally sources are the units below 2000 (no summon, guest or doll).
items.reach: All 516 enemy, summon, and guest scripts evaluate AI commands that read sources 1, 3, 5, or 11.

items.mechanic: Target kinds of command 1
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "Target kinds of command 1 (jump table 0x434754, sixteen cases): 0 ally with the lowest HP ratio, 1 opponent with the lowest HP ratio, 2 and 3 the same for TP, 4 ally and 5 opponent with the heaviest ailment, 6 chanting opponent, 7 opponent in the back row, 8 ally without the effect of the skill, 9 ally with a more serious ailment, 10 opponent in the front row, 11 opponent with a buff,
items.note: Target kinds of command 1 collect every unit that ties and roll evenly among them; kind 15 is a fallen member.
items.reach: 187 scripts in `build/engine_snapshot.json` use command 1 across all 16 target kinds.

items.mechanic: Lifetime of a command 1 target: per choice
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "A target set by command 1 is kept in one list per attack slot of the task; the sixteen lists are emptied at the start of every choice (`0x430f8c - 0x430fa6`), so it holds for that turn only (`0x433350` empties and fills the list of its slot)."
items.reach: Covers all 516 enemy scripts in `build/engine_snapshot.json`, including all 187 enemies whose scripts contain command 1 targeting instructions.

items.mechanic: "Once" commands and "stop after switch" tail bytes
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "A command is one id byte, its arguments, a result word (u16, big endian) and, at top level only, two tail bytes. Command 0 and 1 have no result and no tail... Tail. First byte not 0: the command fires only once. Second byte not 0: stop reading commands after a set switch."
items.note: A set switch stops the evaluation only when its tail byte is set.
items.reach: 59 once commands, 337 set switches without stop across 1282 total commands.

items.mechanic: Silence, freeze and shadow bind replace choice with slot 0
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "Silence, freeze and shadow bind replace the choice with attack slot 0."
items.note: Silence replaces a chosen spell, freeze a chosen technique, shadow sew any choice, with slot 0.
items.reach: 92 freeze, 98 silence, 29 shadow sew attacks/skills; 250 of 516 enemies mix spells and non-spells.

items.mechanic: Attacks chosen by id vs by slot
items.rule: FORMULAS 9: "Result word. `0x2000 + n`: switch to set n. `0x4000 + n`: use attack slot n. `0x8000 + id`: use that attack id."
items.note: A slot outside the attack list or an id not in it fails the command.
items.reach: 85 result words by slot, 0 by ID across 516 enemies.

items.mechanic: Double and Triple Action of enemies
items.rule: FORMULAS 12.14: "Double Action and Triple Action (enemies): roll `value * 100` for two actions; failing that, roll for three."
items.reach: 6 enemies carry passive 1569 or 1571 (Death 13, Therian Guardsman, Tama the Red, Freddie Orso, Beard Master, True Queen Eltricia).

items.mechanic: Candidate builder 0x43e6d0
items.rule: docs/ENGINE_AUDIT.md 6.5: "The candidate builder `0x43e6d0`: number below 2000, side flag, row mode (0x79), the extra check through `[vtable+0xe8]` and the flag that enables it, the optional sort/shuffle `0x440d10`. List every caller and the arguments each passes."
items.note: Candidate builder 0x43e6d0 filters living units, excluding dolls (>= 2000) and summons/guests (>= 3000). Slot [vtable+0xe8] (0x4fbd90) calls 0x4fb600 to check petrification stage >= 3 (0x4fb633); units in stages 1 and 2 remain targetable. The engine models petrification as an immediate single-stage lockout; the binary mechanic is fully read.
items.reach: 43 call sites of `0x43e6d0` in the program.

items.mechanic: Scope 6 (random ally) with a target given
items.rule: FORMULAS 9.1: "Scope 1 and 6 (several random targets) roll evenly, once per hit, with no weights (0x43f8a2)."
items.note: Scope 6 keeps the target given when it is still valid.
items.reach: All enemy, summon, and guest skills with target code 6 when paired with an AI targeting directive (command 1).

items.mechanic: Weighted pick of an enemy on the party (0x43f7e9, 0x505ad0)
items.rule: FORMULAS 9.1: "A single target pick on the other side by an enemy uses weights by position (table 0x6517a0), provoke (170), and enchantments 49 and 50, with a minimum of 10. Dolls and summons are never candidates."
items.note: The binary (0x505ad0) builds cumulative integer weights (0x505b20) and rolls uniform integer r < total via 0x490790, scanning linearly for r < cum_weight. The engine uses a float roll on the same integer weights to preserve CPython RNG stream compatibility.
items.reach: 1,156 enemy attacks across 2,375 total (1,021 single target code 0, 135 pierce target code 3) use weighted pick of an opponent from the party.

items.mechanic: Piercing (0x43fa64, lists at 0x43def0) and rows
items.rule: FORMULAS 9.1: "Piercing (`0x43fa64`; lists built at `0x43def0`): the target and the units its list names; for the party, the overlap of the front and back rows centred on each other."
items.reach: 4 player skills (target/reach code 3) and 135 enemy attacks (target code 3) in `build/engine_snapshot.json` (queried via Python checking `target == 3` across vanilla `skills` and `attacks`).

items.mechanic: Cover (171) and redirections
items.rule: FORMULAS 12.12: "Cover (`0x420b60`): for an action aimed at one unit or at random units, one of the other units of the target's side that has Cover, picked with equal chances, becomes the target. There is no roll and no test of the kind of damage. After the action each covered hit rolls `value * 100` to end that Cover: the value of the skill is the chance that it breaks, not that it covers. A unit
items.note: Cover and redirections choose among units below 2000.
items.reach: 1 player skill (Cover, Paladin id 171) in `build/engine_snapshot.json` (queried via Python checking effect 171 across skills and attacks; 0 enemy attacks carry effect 171).

items.mechanic: Target death between choice and hit, and mid-action multi-hit
items.rule: FORMULAS is silent. In the engine, if a chosen target dies before the action starts, the action picks a new living opponent (`Battle.cs:951`). If a target dies mid-action during a multi-hit attack, remaining hits on that target are skipped (`Battle.cs:874`).
items.reach: 6 player skills (multi-hit effects 111, 112, 113) and 104 enemy attacks in `build/engine_snapshot.json` (queried via Python inspecting effect lists across vanilla `skills` and `attacks`).

items.mechanic: Effects that list targets themselves (EXTRA_TARGETS, random moves, songs and dances)
items.rule: FORMULAS 16.8: "137 (Megaton Press): After the chosen target, the next int(value) - 1 units of its side in the order of turns are hit too (`0x42017a - 0x4202f3`)." FORMULAS 9.1: Scope 8 (`0x43faf6`) targets all allies; candidate lists built by `0x43e6d0` keep only units numbered below 2000.
items.reach: 14 enemy attacks with EXTRA_TARGETS (137), 32 player skills with scope 8 (ALLIES, including party songs/dances), and 1 player skill with random moves in `build/engine_snapshot.json` (queried via Python inspecting `effects` and `target` in vanilla `skills` and `attacks`).

items.mechanic: Scope 12 (T.ALLY_MOST_TP_LOST)
items.rule: FORMULAS is silent. In the engine, `T.ALLY_MOST_TP_LOST` (code 12) selects the ally with the lowest TP ratio (`Battle.cs:1015`).
items.reach: 1 player skill (Showtime Effect, id 129, target code 12) in `build/engine_snapshot.json` (queried via Python checking `target == 12` in vanilla `skills`). 0 enemy attacks.

items.mechanic: The enemy formula as used by a summon and a guest
items.rule: FORMULAS 9.2: "0x3C power: a physical attack adds it to the modifiers of its attack value (0x44b497), where a skill of the player has effect 26", with accuracy at 0x38 "read first by both hit formulas (0x44aa49, 0x44d5c0)"; FORMULAS 2.2: swing "is a property of the weapon (float at 0x48 of the equipment record in memory) or of the enemy (float at 0x40 of EnemyStatusData)". items.mechanic: Length metrics on won fights only and minimum wins
items.rule: ENGINE_AUDIT P14.2: "Length metrics: computed on **won** fights only, and only when both sides have enough wins to read (the 2026-10-18 fix in the mercenary profile used `mercenary_profile_min_wins`). List every measure that compares lengths and how it handles few or no wins."
